note: The cost book AS IT STOOD on the night, pinned. data/lightspeed_recipes_costed.json carries no effective date -- cogs_blend._load_book_costs says so in its own docstring -- so it answers what a pour costs TODAY and cannot answer what it cost in August. Two of these have already moved: Rooster Rojo 1.9641 -> 2.6065 and Lychee Martini 3.9140 -> 5.0328 as at 2026-08-20. Without this file the 8 August fixture would drift a little further from the hand-verified answer every time somebody recosts a recipe, and the regression suite would be measuring the cost book instead of this module. Sourced from the hand sweep and cross-checked against data/products_daily/2026.csv for the same day, where the unit costs published that morning agree (Appleton 2.2543, Casa Gheller Prosecco Glass 3.3480, White Light 1.5208, Sailor Jerry 2.0293). mixer.note: The [House] suffix finds 119 pours on the Dazzle drinks tab and the hand sweep costed 120. One Jack Daniels is the only line that reconciles it -- a nip-only recipe served long exactly like a house pour, without the suffix.
